correctness.rationale: The exact connected-circulation normal form is proved bidirectionally on the four-vertex order-two de Bruijn graph. Balances give x,y,t; the two only possible disconnected positive loops force zero-loop exclusions. Composition p=t+x+a, q=t+y+h factors the number of solutions. Summing the resulting rational series yields the displayed bivariate and univariate generating functions. The pole of order five at one with coefficient 1/12 gives n^4/288. The packaged stdlib verifier independently checks all composition classes through length 18, all vector entries against the characterization, and 120 generating-function coefficients. These finite checks do not replace the proof.
